# Gabriel Catimbang

Gabriel 'Gab' Catimbang — developer & DevOps engineer from Naga City, Philippines. I build websites people actually use, keep them alive, and win hackathons for fun.

Canonical: https://gabcat.dev/
Contact: https://gabcat.dev/contact
Email: catimbanggabriel@gmail.com

## About

Before writing code, Gabriel spent three years on the other side of a support chat at Bell Canada. That listening habit now sits behind full-stack products and the infrastructure that keeps them running.

## Toolbox

- Building: Next.js, React, Vue & Nuxt, NestJS, TypeScript
- Keeping it alive: Docker, AWS, GitHub Actions, Nginx, Linux
- Remembering things: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Convex
- Curveballs: Unreal Engine, C++, Gemini AI, CTF forensics

Started as an apprentice, shipped full-stack within six months. Vue, Nuxt, Express — learned fast, built faster.

### Webmaster — ThePILLARS Publication

The person they call so the site never goes down. Deployments, security, and automating the boring parts.

### DevOps Engineer — Detken Development

Moved production off Vercel onto servers we control, wired up pipelines that deploy themselves, and locked the doors properly.

Built digital products with a team that ships fast — Next.js in front, NestJS in back.

## Selected work

### MerchTrack
University merch, minus the chaos.
An e-commerce platform for campus merchandise. 2,750+ students used it in the first week — the servers held, and so did I.
Tech: Next.js, PostgreSQL, Redis
Link: https://github.com/gab-cat

### CS Guild
A digital home for computer studies students.
The hub where AdNU's computer studies community gathers — events, projects, and people. I lead the tech behind it as CTO.
Tech: Next.js, NestJS
Link: https://csguild.tech

### Games of the Generals
The classic Filipino strategy game, now online.
Real-time multiplayer for the board game every Filipino household argues over. Play your friends from anywhere.
Tech: Convex, Vite, Realtime
Link: https://github.com/gab-cat

### Your Daily Tarot
Your cards, read before your coffee.
A Messenger bot that deals you a daily tarot reading, written by AI with suspiciously good intuition.
Tech: Convex, Gemini, Messenger API
Link: https://github.com/gab-cat
